title: How much do you think like a cryptanalyst?

questions.question: You are an adventurer seeking out new employment. You:
answers: offer protection to a traveling party
help a queen plan the defenses for her new fortress
enter a contest to break out of a supposedly-impenetrable dungeon
raid the tower of an evil wizard to gain magical artifacts
retire from adventuring and open a coffee shop

questions.question: You're reading a book and a character says something you don't understand. You:
answers: immediately try to figure out what it's hinting at
must have missed something earlier, or it's written confusingly
figure it's something that hasn't been explained yet and keep reading

questions.question: Your friend asks you what you think of their project. You generally like it, but you see some potential problems. You:
answers: just say nice things—you're their friend, it's your job to support them, not criticize them
give them the feedback—it doesn't help them make it better if you don't tell them how it could improve

questions.question: Have you ever picked a lock?
answers: yes
no
no, but I know how

questions.question: You're playing a (janky) videogame. There's a big mountain between you and your goal. You:
answers: go around, on the intended path
try to jump between the rocks to find an unintended path over the mountain
rage quit
go into the game files and remove collisions on the mountain object so you can walk through it

questions.question: Do you always try to follow the rules?
answers: yes
almost always
no

questions.question: Your friend starts using a new phrase in conversation a lot. You:
answers: probably don't notice
notice, but don't think much about it
wonder who they picked it up from
start counting how many times they say it in a conversation
